title: Reasoning Effort option missing from Model Settings, causing agent errors
body:
### 📦 Platform

Self hosting Docker

### 📦 Deploymenet mode

server db(lobe-chat-database image)

### 📌 Version

v1.90.4

### 💻 Operating System

Ubuntu

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

The "**Reasoning Effort**" option is no longer visible in the Model Settings regardless of which model is selected. It appears only for a very limited set of models (e.g., ChatGPT), and only directly within the chat interface not in the main model settings panel. For models like DeepSeek-R1, Gemini, etc., the setting is completely unavailable.

This causes a major problem: I have multiple agents configured with default reasoning levels like "DeepThink," and now when I switch to a model that doesn't support it, the agent throws an error saying "This model does not support deep thinking." There's no way to disable or change the reasoning effort from settings as before.

The issue persists across all environments:

**Desktop Firefox and Chrome (Ubuntu)**
**Mobile device (Firefox, Chrome, Galaxy Browser)**

Self-hosted using Docker database deployment (which I always keep updated to the latest version immediately upon release)

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

1. Open LobeChat (Docker db image).
2. Access to Model Settings from saved agent.
3. Reasoning Effort no longer appear at all (normally apear right after **max token lim** option)
4. Use an agent that was Reasoning effort enabled, and use a non deepthink model.
5. Chat throws an error that the model does not support reasoning effort, with no way to turn it off (disable).

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

The "Reasoning Effort" option should be accessible from the Model Settings panel for all models, even if it's disabled or the current model for this agent don't have thinking feature.

There should be a clear UI option to disable or modify reasoning effort per model, especially to avoid runtime errors with agents that default to unsupported settings.

### 📝 Additional Information

Issue happens on all devices and platforms I tested.

My setup uses the official Docker image, updated regularly.

Previously, this option was always visible in settings, regardless of the selected model.

This regression affects the usability of multi-agent workflows significantly.
